description.name: Architecture & Security
description.text: Built a literacy platform using Next.js, Express.js, and MongoDB featuring secure authentication (JWT via httpOnly cookies), Zustand, and TanStack Query (with skeleton loading).

description.name: Core Platform Features
description.text: Developed content management features (CRUD posts), reading history, bookmarking system, and user profile management.

description.name: DevOps & Microservices
description.text: Managed isolated deployments via Docker (Vercel & Render) and prepared a FastAPI microservices migration for Collaborative Filtering & Naive Bayes recommendation features.
